title: Real workerd persistence passes; bounded document reaches capacity in the smoke workload
statement: Two clean runtime smoke runs pass HTTP contribution/reply/rediscovery, authorization boundaries, concurrency, failed-commit rollback and persistence across disposal and a new Miniflare instance. The repeated-observation fixture reaches 83 contributions at 1045331 bytes and rejects the next write without state loss; 200 contributions cannot be measured under the unchanged 1 MiB cap. Retry detection was narrowed to the named CHECK-failure message.
conditions: Local Linux workerd/D1 only; not deployed verification.
CPU and RSS are whole-workerd-process measurements including D1/runtime, not isolate or billing measurements.
83 is specific to this corpus and repeated-observation workload with generated proposals and durable receipts; not a general contribution count limit.
No cap increase or schema rewrite; capacity rejection currently appears as HTTP 500 internal_error.
The context packet cutoff 93a5445150d0 is an ancestor of the task baseline, not current state.
